goal: PD196(d) steps 1-2: build claudeDev\t0stamp.dll (per-site QPC stamps, sites 0..63, dump every 1024th + at unload) and self-test it outside LabVIEW; then one CLFN stamp node on a scratch VI
why: PD196(a)-(c): in-VI bracketing and LV-primitive stamps are unreachable with our verbs, the profiler is dropped, and display is minor. A CLFN completion stamp on a wire branch is the in-situ per-bead timer that step 3 (instrumented D1_s1_t0 copy) needs; also needed for every later loop split.
rules: D src: tools/t0stamp/t0stamp.c + build script + selftest there; any installed compiler, report which
D bitness: match LabVIEW 2026 as MEASURED (report it); export int32_t stamp(int32_t site, void* any), cdecl
D out dir: env T0STAMP_DIR, else <dll dir>\t0stamp_out; file t0_site<SS>_pid<PID>.bin per site+process
D format: little-endian int64; first record = QueryPerformanceFrequency, then raw QPC counts in call order
D dump: a site's buffer written on its every 1024th stamp; all sites flushed at DLL_PROCESS_DETACH
D threads: thread-safe, atomic per-site index, per-site lock only around a flush; no alloc on hot path
D arg: `any` never dereferenced; return 0 ok, nonzero for site outside 0..63 (no write)
D CLFN: param 2 Adapt to Type, CONSTANT, handle passing that avoids a copy (report which); any thread
never open-for-edit or save D1_s1_copy, kswap, the L2-A1 bed or any original; the scratch VI is new
step 1 fully first (no LabVIEW); step 2 only after step 1 passes; each step saves its artefact
every LabVIEW command under bgrun; close every reference; LabVIEW verified gone before you return
no GUI: the CLFN is configured by script (build_clfn or its op)
if a D CLFN item cannot be set by script, report WHICH and what it got; no silent workaround
facts only, no design recommendation; result/1 <=10 facts <=3 open
pass: claudeDev\t0stamp.dll exists; md5 + size + compiler + bitness reported
selftest A (no LabVIEW): 3000 calls site 7 -> 1 file = frequency record + 3000 monotone stamps after unload (>=2048 before unload)
selftest B: 2 threads interleaving sites 3 and 9 -> exactly 2 files, each monotone, counts = calls; site 64 -> nonzero return, no file
selftest C: process handle count flat over 10 load-stamp-unload rounds
scratch VI claudeDev\t0stamp_scratch_<ts>.vi, new, by script: 2-D U16 array (e.g. 1024x1280) to its consumer AND branched into one CLFN stamp; ExecState 1; saved by script
scratch runs write the stamp file; per-call cost median and p99 in us (>=1000 calls); whether the 2-D array is copied (vs a CLFN-free twin, or buffer-allocation read)
LabVIEW handle count flat (+-100) over 20 runs of the scratch VI
one negative case caught: CLFN at a missing DLL path -> ExecState 0 / error, OR site 64 from LabVIEW -> nonzero, no file
